name: Pay for My Call with a Kiss
source:
You are working in a hostess club as a private escort. This is just a cover, however, to mask your true purpose --- hunting the murderer of your parents.

But a man has spun your plan off its track. He might be poison. After all, he is the best friend and partner of your bitter enemy. Can you resist his charms?!? The game challenges you to balance love and revenge...which will you choose?

[From the App Store]
translation:
你在陪酒俱乐部担任私人陪侍，但这只是掩护；你的真正目的，是追查杀害父母的凶手。

然而，一个男人打乱了你的计划。他或许是毒药，毕竟他是你宿敌最好的朋友兼搭档。你能抵挡他的魅力吗？！游戏将考验你如何平衡爱情与复仇……你会选择哪一边？

[摘自App Store]
